object.name: evi_gigaverb
object.digest: Classic gigaverb reverb algorithm, mono in / stereo out, fdn / allpass
object.description: A mono-in, stereo-out reverb implementation by Juhana Sadeharju. Originally Max/MSP-ified by Olaf Matthes (2004) Version 1.0test5, (c) 1999-2006 Juhana Sadeharju / Olaf Matthes. Originally Gen-ified by Graham Wakefield (2011). 64-bit MSP reference version by Volker Böhm (2016). This evieve version with updated filtering and parameter smooting. In gen~ alone (as opposed to the MSP abstraction <o>evi.gigaverb~</o>) this is tricky to use as the damping coefficients are produced externally via the 'evi_damp_coeffs.gendsp' abstraction. See 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculations alternatives.

inlets.name: audioin
inlets.digest: Audio input mono / left / 1, depending on @stereo attribute.

inlets.name: audioin
inlets.digest: Audio input nothing / right / 2, depending on @stereo attribute.

attributes.name: bandwidth
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, 'This is like a damping control for the input, it has a similar effect to the damping control, but is subtly different.'

attributes.name: bypass
attributes.description: 0/1, 'Bypass, signal unaffected when set to 1. Can be used to compare reverb signal with original signal and to save CPU power when gigaverb~ is not used.'

attributes.name: damping
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, lowpass if 1, bypass if 0, shelving in between, 'This controls the high frequency damping (a lowpass filter), values near 0 will make it sound very bright, values near 1 will make it sound very dark.'

attributes.name: decay
attributes.description: Otherwise known as @reverb, decay time in seconds, 0.1..360, 'Reverb decay time, in seconds. 7 is a good place to start. 0.1..360 seconds'

attributes.name: dry
attributes.description: In dB -90..0, 'The level of the unreverberated signal.'

attributes.name: early
attributes.description: In dB -90..0, 'The quantity of early reflections (scatter reflections directly from the source). Think of Lexicon's ambiance patches.'

attributes.name: highshelfG
attributes.description: Pre warped damping highshelf frequency coefficient normalised 0..1, see 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculators.

attributes.name: highshelfK
attributes.description: Pre warped damping highshelf gain coefficient -3..1, see 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculators.

attributes.name: late
attributes.description: In dB -90..0, 'The level of the classic reverb tail reflections.'

attributes.name: lowshelfG
attributes.description: Pre warped damping lowshelf frequency coefficient normalised 0..1, see 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculators.

attributes.name: lowshelfK
attributes.description: Pre warped damping lowshelf gain coefficient -3..1, see 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculators.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: In meters, 0.1..300, 'The size of the room, in meters. Excessively large, and excessively small values will make it sound a bit unrealistic. Values of around 30 sound good.'

attributes.name: smoothtime
attributes.description: Set the smoothing time in ms of all the internal parameter smoothing functions.

attributes.name: spread
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, stereo spread (or 'width'), offsets L/R levels. Note, in Juhana Sadeharju and Graham Wakefield verions this is not available (fixed). In Olaf Matthes version this is object creation argument only. In evieve this can be modified in realtime at any time.

attributes.name: stereo
attributes.description: This is essentially a mono-in stereo-out reverb, but you can toggle 'stereo' 'on' ('1') to explicitly control L/R signals into the late diffusion section (and dry L/R). Default '0' 'off' (mono-in, stereo-out).
